base_dir.description: Base directory where mailing list directories are stored.

web_user.description: System user account under which mlmmj processes (web interface, cron jobs) run.

sendmail_path.description: Path to the sendmail (or compatible MTA) binary.

default_charset.description: Default character set for list messages.

default_moderated.description: Whether new mailing lists should be moderated by default.

default_sub_policy.description: Default subscription policy: 'open' (no confirmation), 'confirm' (email confirmation), or 'admin-only'.

default_digest_mode.description: Default delivery mode for new lists: 'normal' (individual messages), 'digest', or 'both'.

default_digest_freq.description: Default digest frequency (in days) for digest delivery.

max_attach_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of attachments allowed in messages.

num_workers.description: Number of worker threads for background tasks (e.g., bounce processing).

sanitize_html.description: Whether to sanitize HTML in messages to prevent XSS and other injection attacks.

html_sanitization_rules_path.description: Optional path to a custom HTML sanitization rules file (e.g., 'libwww-perl' style). Leave empty to use built-in rules.

archive.description: Whether to archive messages to disk.

archive_dir.description: Subdirectory (relative to list directory) or absolute path where archived messages are stored.

subscriber_confirm.description: Whether to send confirmation emails for subscription requests.

welcome.description: Whether to send a welcome message when a user subscribes.

farewell.description: Whether to send a farewell message when a user unsubscribes.

reject_notice.description: Whether to notify senders when their message is rejected (e.g., due to moderation).

admin_notify.description: Whether to notify list administrators when moderation actions (e.g., approve/reject) occur.

verify_sender.description: Whether to verify sender addresses against SPF/DKIM records.

verify_recipient.description: Whether to verify recipient addresses exist before accepting messages.

hide_list.description: Whether to hide this list from public list directories.

auto_create.description: Whether to automatically create a list upon first subscription request.

hostname.description: Hostname to use in generated URLs, email headers, and confirmation links.

web_url.description: Public base URL for the web interface (list subscription management).

archive_url.description: Public base URL for archived messages.

default_bounce_handling.description: Action for bounced messages: 'discard' (ignore), 'hold' (queue for admin review), or 'notify' (notify admin).

max_bounces.description: Maximum number of bounced messages before automatically unsubscribing the address.

bounce_hold.description: Time (in seconds) to hold bounce notifications before auto-unsubscribing.

mime_digest.description: Whether to use MIME-encoded digests (required for non-text attachments).

daily_digest.description: Whether digests should be daily (instead of periodic/batched).

digest_include_msgid.description: Whether to include message IDs in digest summaries.

digest_include_headers.description: Whether to include full message headers in digests (may increase size).

extra_headers.description: Additional headers to append to outgoing messages (e.g., for compliance or branding).

allowed_domains.description: List of domains whose members may subscribe or post (e.g., 'example.org'). Leave empty to allow all.

banned_senders.description: List of banned sender email addresses or regexes (e.g., '^spam.*@.*\.ru$').

items.description: Sender email pattern to block (supports basic regex)

allowed_attachment_types.description: List of allowed MIME types for attachments (e.g., 'image/png', 'application/pdf'). Empty = allow all.

disabled_commands.description: List of administrative commands to disable (e.g., 'subscribe', 'unsubscribe', 'set').
